channel.title: Pikomofu — pins from the garden
channel.description: The little garden in Pikomofu, drawn each day under that day's real sky.

item.title: Morning in the little garden · 朝の おにわ
item.description: Morning comes to the garden at the real sunrise. A pixel American Shorthair is already up. Pikomofu is a cozy pixel pet app for iPhone: a little garden under the real sky, where the time of day, the seasons and the moon are real. One pet free, no ads. おにわの朝は、ほんとうの日の出の時刻に。アメショはもう起きています。Pikomofu（ピコモフ）は、ほんとうの空の下のちいさなおにわで、ドット絵の犬や猫と暮らす iPhone アプリです。1匹無料・広告なし。 #pixelart #cozygames #kawaii #virtualpet #ドット絵 #ピコモフ
